description: Search England's scheduled monuments by name and get list entry number, date scheduled, area in hectares, grid reference and official link. Scheduling gives legal protection: works, and metal detecting, on a scheduled monument need consent. For landowners, detectorists, developers and walkers. Source: Historic England National Heritage List for England. Name match only; most archaeology is not scheduled, so no match does not mean a site is unprotected or unrecorded. (cost: 1 credit)

name.description: string, required, part of the monument name, e.g. 'Stonehenge' (case-insensitive, 2-100 chars)

name: scheduled_monument_search
